title: ChIP \(Chromatin Immunoprecipitation)
protocol: Collect approximately 5 × 10^8 cells from an exponentially growing yeast culture.
Crosslink the cells by adding formaldehyde 1% (v/v) to the growth medium and incubate for 15 min.
Stop crosslinking by adding glycine 125 mM and incubate for 5 minutes.
Collect the cells by centrifugation at 4000xg and wash four times with 25 mL of cold TBS buffer at 4°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 μL of Lysis buffer.
Lyse the cells by vortexing with glass beads for 30 min at 4°C, supplementing with lysis buffer to a final volume of 600 μL.
Fragment the chromatin by sonication using a BioRuptor Diagenode with discontinuous pulses for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the sample at 13400xg for 15 min at 4°C.
Keep 20 μl from the supernatant as a control of whole-cell extract (Input).
Incubate the remaining volume with orbital rotation for 2 h at 4°C with Dynabeads Protein G previously bound to a specific antibody.
Wash the beads 4 times in PBS containing 0.02% (v/v) Tween 20.
Elute the bound protein with two times 40 μL of Elution buffer by heating at 65°C for 8 min.
Revert the cross-linking by overnight incubation at 65°C shaking.
Digest the eluted sample for 90 min at 37°C with 0.33 mg/mL proteinase K.
Purify the DNA using the High Pure PCR product purification kit.
Analyse the co-immunoprecipitated DNA in triplicate by quantitative PCR in a DNA Engine Peltier Thermal Cycler using the SYBR® Premix Ex TaqTM Tli RNase H Plus Green with ROX.
